integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium close-up slightly high-angle shot frames a light wooden dining table by a window, warm morning side light falling across the surface. A woven wicker fruit basket sits on the table, holding one glossy red apple inside. A young Chinese woman in a loose cream knit sweater reaches into the frame from the upper side, picks up the red apple from the basket, and lifts it toward her mouth. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as she takes a crisp bite from the apple, her teeth sinking into the skin, a small piece of flesh breaking off; she chews softly, then lowers the apple and sets it gently back down on the wooden tabletop beside the basket, the bitten side facing the camera. Her hand withdraws from the frame, leaving the apple resting on the table with a clear bite mark. Shallow depth of field, warm natural tones, 35mm lens, subtle film grain.

overall_soundscape: Quiet room ambience with faint distant morning street noise. A soft rustle of the wicker basket as her hand reaches in, followed by the crisp snap of apple skin breaking as she takes a bite, a few slow chewing sounds, and finally the soft contact of the apple being set back down on the wooden table.
